messages:
maya: FYI - customer reported a 413 on /v1/rerank. ticket #3257. says they sent a long query + ~120 docs and got a generic 413 Payload Too Large. they're confused which limit they hit.
devin.eng: can you paste the request body they sent? rough sizes (chars/tokens) ok.
maya: copying slack-safe excerpt from the customer (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "<~1200 char query>",
  "docs": [ { "id": "a", "text": "<~22k char doc>" }, ... ]
}
```
They also included: "error": "413 Payload Too Large" and no further details. customer expects: which field broke the limit (query length vs single doc vs total docs) and the numeric limit.
devin.eng: thanks. quick repro attempt on my end returned same 413. our gateway just bubbles up 413 from reranker service without limit metadata. logs show: rerank_service: request_size_bytes=235000, total_docs=120, longest_doc_chars=22000.

sam.sre: that matches. gateway doesn't insert guidance. UX issue: customers are guessing between token vs char vs doc_count limits. we should surface at least: max_docs, max_total_tokens, or max_doc_chars. also add link to docs.

maya: customer asked for mitigation steps. I suggested: 1) trim docs to first N chars, 2) chunk large docs + rerank per-chunk, 3) use embedding+vector-search to prefilter, 4) fallback to our /relevance endpoint. they want a clear KB snippet we can paste.

devin.eng: agree on mitigation. also, small note: our code uses tokenization for enforcement but error is raised based on byte/char thresholds at the edge. mismatch causes confusion. I'll open an eng task to unify enforcement to token-based with clearer metric in error payload.

repro-bot: repro summary: reproduced at 2026-02-12T14:02Z. payload size 229KB. service returned 413 with empty body. stack: gateway -> rerank-svc(v2) -> reject.

sam.sre: proposed error payload (for discussion):
```json
{
  "error": "RequestTooLarge",
  "message": "Request exceeded allowed rerank limits. See fields for which limit was hit.",
  "limits": {
    "max_docs": 100,
    "max_total_tokens": 65536,
    "max_doc_chars": 16384
  },
  "rejected": {
    "total_docs": 120,
    "total_tokens_est": 90000,
    "longest_doc_chars": 22000
  },
  "help_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits"
}
```

maya: love that. please make sure message mentions both tokens and chars and a quick remediation bullet list we can paste to the customer. also ask docs team to add examples for chunking + a sample curl.

devin.eng: will do. I'll: 1) create an internal PR to enrich 413 body (gateway + rerank svc), 2) add SDK mapping to throw a RequestTooLargeError with fields, 3) add a docs PR for KB snippet. assigning myself, ETA EOD tomorrow.

sam.sre: also flagging this for the next release notes - breaking change in error shape but better UX. add a migration note for integrators.

maya: sending the customer interim reply with mitigation steps and ETA. tagged #docs to add KB link when ready. :thumbsup
